Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

today adverb

nowadays

also nowadays, these days, in our time

classical

Cic. Lael. 43: quālis hodiē sit (Lewis & Short)
Liv. 30.30.10: id tū hodiē es
Traupman 88: nowadays, hodiē, nunc

hodiē

adverb

today, nowadays, at the present day

Hodiēque, still today, is post-Augustan (Plin. NH 16.15; Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • quod ego fuī ad Trasumennum, ad Cannās, id tū hodiē es

    what I was at Trasimene and at Cannae, you are todayLiv. 30.30.10

  • quīn et hodiēque per Hispāniās secundīs mēnsīs glāns īnseritur

    why, even today acorns are served as dessert all over SpainPlin. NH 16.15

Other words

  • nunc — now, these days

    adverb · also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.57 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 88

  • nostrā aetāte — in our time, nowadays

    also used · classical · Quint. 1.4.20 (Lewis & Short, s.v. aetās)

See also today, now.

SourcesLewis & Short: hodie · Lewis & Short: nunc · Lewis & Short: aetas
